notes: Egypt Nile Delta DLC crops pack (EconomyFile + CropsPackFile format, merged by id). fieldCrops with regions [nile_delta] are only sold and planted on that map; wheat, onion and potato from the base game stay available on both maps. Delta agronomy (MALR / FAO): rice is transplanted in May-June and harvested in September (summer, ~125 days, flooded paddy, ~9-10 t/ha paddy); Egyptian long-staple cotton (Giza varieties) is sown in March-April and picked in September (spring-summer, ~180 days, ~2.6 t/ha seed cotton = 8 kantar/feddan); berseem (Egyptian clover, Trifolium alexandrinum) is the winter forage and nitrogen crop, sown in October, 4 cuts until April (feeds the animals: feedPerKg); summer (nili) maize ~115 days, ~8 t/ha. growSeconds = 1.6 s per real day like the Saudi crops, yields use the same ~11.5 kg per t/ha scale, prices are game-balance values relative to wheat (2024 Egyptian farm-gate prices: paddy ~1.2x wheat, seed cotton ~5x, maize ~0.9x, fresh berseem ~0.15x). model = crop whose stage models are used as a placeholder until the DLC has its own plants.
